candidates.snippet: More footage of LVDS Samara burning. https://t.co/TRgdI4YiN5 https://t.co/ScgcRIhOOh

Exilenova+ says the Oct 2 hit on LVDS Samara set 5 RVS-20000 and 3 RVS-50000 tanks on fire and damaged pipelines and a pump station. Fire area 15,000+ sq m. Losses with oil are estimated at about $200m. https://t.co/V3RMNeRPCc https://t.co/wBGYwFtAVd

Ukrainian fighters from Lasar’s Group downed another jet-powered Geran-5 using the P1-SUN JetKiller, their second in recent days, intercepting it on a head-on crossing course. Five interceptor drones now have video-confirmed Geran-5 kills. https://t.co/hrI7I1gl7y
